diagnosis: The remote cache metadata endpoint retrieves build execution metadata using artifactHash without verifying that the requesting CI token belongs to the organization or project that generated the cache. Because environmentVariables contains build-time secrets, private NPM tokens, and database URLs captured during compilation, an attacker with read access to the cache can extract sensitive credentials across projects.
exploit_request:
GET /api/cache/artifacts/e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3/metadata HTTP/1.1
Host: monorepo-cache.corp.com
Authorization: Bearer ci_token_frontend_docs
